title: Sensor Open
fullDescription: Humidity/temp sensor reads open circuit; sensor cooking unavailable.

title: Magnetron Overheat
fullDescription: Magnetron thermostat sensed high temp; cooling fan or vent issue.

fixSteps.title: Test fan
fixSteps.instruction: Verify cooling fan spins on cook cycle.

title: Stuck Key
fullDescription: Same as E4 on some models.

fixSteps.title: Replace coupler
fixSteps.instruction: Remove glass tray and swap drive coupler.

title: HV Transformer Fault
fullDescription: Transformer or diode failed; no microwave output.

title: Communication Lost
fullDescription: UI to main board ribbon disconnected.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat ribbon between display and main board.
